I will use a little chemical fertilizer and some manure to help the poor soil, but I will still depend mostly on the rains since I have no irrigation on this land. I will plant my local sorghum seed with intercrop as usual, and I do not expect to spray pesticide, though I may clear weeds with family effort and a little hired help.
